context: Sentences from Wikipedia about the domain "Book Ontology". Use only these relations, written exactly as given: illustrator (any -> human); followed by (any -> value); publication date (book -> value); author (book -> human); publisher (book -> publisher); characters (literary work -> fictional character); editor (trade magazine -> human); place of publication (any -> value); narrative location (literary work -> territory); genre (literary work -> literary genre); language of work or name (literary work -> language); depicts (any -> value).
